{"reason": "All 8 failure rows are demand-forecast-error misrouted to unknown: five have market-signal-mismatch only (amounts 45k-254k), three have small bias 0.065-0.081 just under the 0.1 cut. I extend the forecast branch with an or on market-signal-mismatch and lower the bias threshold to 0.06, converting 14 costly unknowns into recovered claims.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
         (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.06)))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
